key.name: destination-kind
key.summary: Kind of backup destination: disk, folder, network, cloud or plugin

key.name: destination-id
key.summary: File system UUID of the backup disk

key.name: destination-path
key.summary: Folder or mounted network share that holds the backups

key.name: destination-name
key.summary: Name of the backup destination shown to the user

key.name: destination-encrypted
key.summary: Whether the backup disk is encrypted

key.name: destination-plugin
key.summary: Destination plugin that stores the backups when the kind is plugin

key.name: destination-target
key.summary: Target inside the destination plugin, such as an online account

key.name: destination-repository
key.summary: Name of the backup set to use at the destination; empty means this computer

key.name: encrypt-remote
key.summary: Encrypt backups kept in online accounts and other remote destinations

key.name: exclusions
key.summary: Files and folders that are never backed up
key.description: Names match anywhere, a leading slash anchors a path to the home folder, and * and ? work as wildcards.

key.name: retention
key.description: smart keeps hourly backups for a day, daily backups for a month and weekly backups before that, plus always the latest; keep-last keeps the number of backups in keep-last.

key.name: keep-last
key.summary: Number of backups to keep when retention is keep-last

key.name: pause-on-battery
key.summary: Pause automatic backups when the battery is low

key.name: battery-threshold
key.summary: Battery level in percent under which automatic backups pause while on battery

key.name: notify-completed
key.summary: Notify when a backup you started finishes

key.name: start-delay
key.summary: Seconds to wait after login before a backup that is due
